incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected on api.redwood.com at 2024-10-21T16:12:00Z. Paging on-call rotation: @maya
maya: oncall here, seeing a spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts from the edge LB. dashboard shows global 5xx rate jumped to ~18% at 16:10 UTC
lucas: I'm looking at envoy metrics now. top error codes are 502 and 503. upstream host failures + stream reset counts climbing
maya: customer reports: a handful of product dashboards failing to load; CS says 3 customers reported errors in last 20m, not a full outage but high impact for some flows
devon: can someone grab the LB route weight / retry policy rollout history? I want to see if a recent config pushed to gateway changed retry behavior
jen: checking deploys — no code deploys to gateway in last hour. but I see a config commit at 15:58 that adjusted route weights for canary traffic on /v1/generate
lucas: sending envoy admin stats snapshot, focusing on cluster model-srv and cluster model-srv-fallback
lucas: ```
# envoy cluster stats (snippet)
cluster.model-srv.upstream_rq_5xx: 421
cluster.model-srv.upstream_rq_503: 318
cluster.model-srv.upstream_rq_502: 83
cluster.model-srv.upstream_cx_reset: 91
cluster.model-srv.retry_or_shadow_abandoned: 74
```
maya: those retry_or_shadow_abandoned lines worry me — looks like retries are amplifying errors
devon: hypothesis: retry policy + route weight shift caused increased load on model-srv and exhausted its connection pool -> CB tripping -> 5xx
ryan: I'm ssh'd into the LB control plane. I can shadow traffic to the fallback pool (model-srv-fallback) and temporarily reduce retries at the gateway
maya: do it. set retries -> 0 on the gateway route and shift 20% traffic to fallback. want minimal config change.
jen: how to patch quickly? lucas, can you apply a runtime override in the envoy cluster? alternatively, we can patch the gateway configmap and reload
lucas: runtime override available — applying now: `curl -X POST "http://envoy-admin.local/runtime_modify?key=routes.v1.retries&value=0"`
lucas: applied. verifying stats...
lucas: after override: ```
cluster.model-srv.retry_or_shadow_abandoned: 12
cluster.model-srv.upstream_rq_5xx: 129
cluster.model-srv.upstream_rq_503: 97
```
maya: nice drop in retry amplification, but 5xx still elevated. proceed with traffic shift to fallback
ryan: shifting weights via LB API: `POST /v1/routes/edge/shift {"route":"/v1/generate","weight_shift":-20}` -> pushing
ryan: shift applied, verifying telemetry
lucas: metrics after 60s: total 5xx rate down to ~6%, fallback cluster error rate stable. latency for served requests improved
sarah-cs: CS update: notified affected customers with a brief note, no active pages from them now. they saw intermittent 502s in product, engineering working on it
maya: good. I will stay on for handoff. lucas, can you take primary while I start writing the incident summary and initiate customer impact form?
lucas: taking primary, will keep monitoring and dive into root cause. initial theory: route weight push + retry policy inadvertently concentrated transient failures onto model-srv and triggered circuit breaker/backpressure
ops-jen: creating an alert to detect retry amplification patterns: compare retry_or_shadow_abandoned / upstream_rq_total over 5m
devon: action items for postmortem: 1) make retry_policy changes guarded by canary ramp and circuit-breaker-aware heuristics 2) add preflight checks when changing route weights 3) improve runbook on immediate mitigations (runtime override + shift)
maya: agreed. I'll file the incident ticket and include timeline + logs. starting handoff to lucas in 10m.
incident-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF — maya handing off to lucas for continued mitigation and RCA. Pager note: lucas is primary for the incident
lucas: I'll collect envoy admin dumps and model-srv connection pool logs. if we see a single instance causing resets we'll cordon it from the pool
ryan: quick note — we saw one model instance OOM at 15:52 in logs, kube restarted it at 15:56. could be related if reuse/conn pooling kept hitting unhealthy hosts
lucas: grabbing pod logs now and correlating with envoy outlier detection events
maya: thanks everyone. CS will send a brief update to affected customers saying we mitigated elevated errors by rolling back aggressive retry/weight changes; follow-up with RCA in next 48h
sarah-cs: I'll prepare the customer-facing post-incident note and draft up affected endpoints and approximate error window
devon: postmortem owners: lucas (RCA + fix), jen (deployment guardrails), ryan (LB rollout playbook), maya (customer comms). Assigning in ticket now
lucas: confirmed last check — 5xx steady at baseline ~0.6%. keeping monitoring for 30m before closing incident
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — error rates returned to normal thresholds at 2024-10-21T16:42:00Z. Incident channel will remain open for notes and RCA drafting.
maya: closing handoff. will reopen if we see resurgence. thanks team :thumbsup:
